threat_intel_match.description: Source IP matched known malicious or suspicious threat intelligence feeds

privileged_user.description: Activity involves a privileged, service, or administrative user account

critical_host.description: Target hostname is identified as a mission-critical asset (e.g. Domain Controller, Database)

suspicious_process_powershell.description: Execution of suspicious PowerShell commands, obfuscation, or download cradles

brute_force_failed_logins.description: Multiple repeated authentication failures from the same source

public_ip_inbound.description: External public IP connection observed reaching internal enterprise network

missing_critical_data.description: Alert has missing fields or degraded data quality preventing full verification
